{{Youmay|a detachment of the Imperial garrison on Vryssa|a [[Alpha Group|sub-group of the Alliance Fleet]]}}
'''Alpha Group''' was the designation provided to a detachment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vryssa]]. It was composed of [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Much of the detachment was destroyed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] when he launched his attack on the Vryssa garrison. Alpha Group was dispatched into the forests of Vryssa by Imperial [[General/Legends|general]] [[Gaege Xarran]] in an attempt to capture or kill Fett, but failed to do so.
